budget.metric: relative error of the simulated steady mean force component (turning, orthogonal cutting) or of the peak / extreme value of a force component (milling) against the reference value
budget.note: main_force_pct: Cutting (tangential, power) component. Measured repeats agree to 1-5 % and the stated measurement scatter is below 10 %, so the references are not the limit. Calibrated models reach 8 % (Loeschner 2025, Zou 2026) and mechanistic milling models 10 % for 85 % of cases with no case above 20 % (Altintas review); literature JC sets alone scatter from -21 % to +70 % (Ducobu 2017). 15 % is therefore achievable with good material data and still discriminates a wrong flow-stress or friction model. | milling_peak_force_pct: Peak or extreme values of Fx, Fy, Fz in milling: the reference is digitised from force-time curves (3-4 % added uncertainty), runout and dynamics add to the cutting-mechanics error; the review's 'maximum deviation in all cases less than 20 %' for mechanistic milling models is taken as the bound. | thrust_force_pct: Feed / thrust / back component in the orthogonal plane. It depends on edge radius, flank contact and friction much more than the main force: calibrated FE models miss it by 14.8 % on average (Zou 2026) and up to 42 % (Loeschner 2025); twenty JC sets give -59 % to +14 % (Ducobu 2017).
